long_biography.plain_text:
Graduating from the Royal College of Surgeons in Ireland in 1997, he pursued plastic and reconstructive surgery in Sweden. Specialist certification led to a consultant post at Malmö University Hospital. He later returned to Qatar and joined Hamad Medical Corporation, where his work included facial reconstruction and treatment of congenital outer-ear conditions.

In 2010 he opened a solo cosmetic clinic, later developing it into Surgi-Art Centre. A strategic partnership enabled a broader hospital project in Lusail, first launched as a specialist facility before expanding into general medicine, paediatrics, dentistry and other surgical services. He now combines clinical practice with management as the hospital's co-owner and chief executive.
